sn3.25:2.5: This extraordinary threat looms also in an Upaniṣadic passage: “Even if both the mountain ranges, the southern and the northern, were to rush at him determined to level him, they would not succeed in leveling him” (Kauṣītaki Upaniṣad 2.13, translation Olivelle).
sn3.25:4.13: _Bhūmigata_ is explained as “underground” at [pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:4.2.1]() (there _bhūmaṭṭha_). | _Vehāsaṭṭha_ is explained as “above ground” at [pli-tv-bu-vb-pj2:4.5.1](). | _Upalāpetuṁ_ (“bribe”) is a means by which Vassakāra suggests the Vajjis can be overcome ([dn16:1.5.8](), [an7.22:12.3]()).
